title: Reform a present familiar on Find Familiar recast (cast-again select-new-form from present)
description:
From eshyra-s02z. SCOPE NARROWED 2026-10-07 (captain): reform a PRESENT familiar on Find Familiar recast (spell:find-familiar transition reform-present-familiar: cast-again, when presence present + link active, operation select-new-form, no presence change). recast_bonded_summon currently refuses any actor that is not absent.

Pocket presence is split out to its own bead (temporary dismissal, recall, reform-while-pocketed, permanent dismissal, Find Steed action-dismissal), because the engine does not model it and dismissal/recall are actions usable mid-combat. Until that lands the engine cannot tell a pocketed familiar from a present one: both are a live actor with an active bond, and reform-pocketed-familiar has the same operation and no presence change, so the executed reform is correct for either. The recorded transition is reform-present-familiar, the only presence the engine models.

Design decisions (captain):
- Selection stays record-driven: choose the cast-again transition whose when.presence matches the actor's modelled presence (absent -> 'absent', alive -> 'present') and whose when.link includes 'active'. Never key on the spell name. Find Steed has no present cast-again transition, so a present steed stays refused (the SRD allows one steed at a time; its recast only restores an absent steed).
- Reform result: same campaign actor, rulesRef = chosen form, hpMax = that creature record's HP, hpCurrent = effective maximum (exhaustion-adjusted), status stays alive. Source basis: "the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form" plus "Your familiar transforms into the chosen creature". Hit points are part of those statistics and the source carries no damage across. Conditions, exhaustion, display name and the vanish-bonded rule stay as stored, as in the absent restore.
- Refuse while the actor has a combatant in an active combat instance (the casting time is 1 hour), and for any actor status other than alive or absent.

Spec and evidence live in the dispatch child.
notes:
HP decision confirmed by user 2026-10-07: a reformed present familiar takes the new form's full HP. Source research the same day found no WotC ruling: the Sage Advice Compendium's two Find Familiar entries cover Help and Sneak Attack only; Crawford tweets and the D&D Beyond Spell Spotlight are silent on HP on reform. Community material is thin and split: one D&D Beyond forum opinion assumes health regenerates on recast; some homebrew variants (Ascended Familiar, Battle Familiar, an Improved Familiar feat) explicitly limit or grant HP. Basis kept: 'has the statistics of the chosen form' + 'transforms into the chosen creature', the same reading the absent restore uses. Docs should present this as the engine's reading of a text that is silent on carried damage, not as an official ruling.
PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/605 opened 2026-10-07 (head b0e71eba); stays in_progress until it merges. Follow-ups: eshyra-82uk (pocket presence), eshyra-qxnc (bond-spell identity + Pact of the Chain forms).
Merged to main via PR #605 (approved head b0e71eba, merge commit b7a578fd) on 2026-10-08.
